card.name: Material word starting a compound name
card.fires_on: The first part of a compound name or noun that begins with a material or plant word, such as Clay, Copper, Steel, Cotton, Cedar, Oil or iron. The next piece usually attaches directly to it.

modes.label: Split proper names
modes.description: A material word begins a company, person or place name written as one joined word.

modes.label: Split common compounds
modes.description: A material word begins a compound noun, often broken across pieces, such as animal or object names.

card.writes: It favors endings that complete compounds, such as -lined, -colored, seed and Chinese words for products and poisoning.
card.plain: It spots a material word like copper or steel at the start of a longer joined name, where more of the name must follow.
